_comment: Snippet for .claude/settings.json (project) to wire the agent-spawn hard-gate hook. Replace <PROJECT_ROOT> with your project path and <PY> with your python interpreter. The hook script lives at hooks/agent_spawn_gate.py (copy it into your project, e.g. <PROJECT_ROOT>/tools/hooks/). It writes runtime state to <PROJECT_ROOT>/data/agent_review/ (gitignore that).
